sections.changelog:
0.15.3

  • Hardened Rent Fetch API bootstrap caching so error responses no longer replace cached credential/token data.
  • Validated central API bootstrap responses before caching them as successful.
  • Cleared cached API bootstrap state, in-request bootstrap state, and property-limit state before starting an accelerated full sync.
  • Validated runtime credentials before provider syncs so missing provider tokens fail explicitly.
  • Prevented Yardi, Entrata, and Rent Manager deletion cleanup from running against blank, malformed, missing-key, request-error, or non-200 API responses.
  • Preserved legitimate empty-provider cleanup behavior when the API explicitly returns a valid empty collection.
